sentences.text: Coprobacter fastidiosus is a bacterium detected by shotgun metagenomic sequencing of stool samples from people.
A complete genome sequence of Coprobacter fastidiosus JCM 33896 consists of a single circular chromosome of 3,444,538 base pairs with a G+C content of 38.4 percent.
Annotation of that genome predicted 15 rRNA genes, 67 tRNA genes and 2,662 protein-coding sequences.
A trial of faecal microbiota transplantation in children with ulcerative colitis reported increases in Coprobacter fastidiosus after transplantation.
A study of patients with epilepsy reported lower relative abundance of the genus Coprobacter in refractory patients than in responsive individuals.
